The commit is an ancestor of pqctoday-hsm origin/main. On-board SHA-256 of /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsmv3.so (d4eb794a0520b894e76dbd26b0d36a1c6cf0a09fcb5c8b94a05aa1e71743e458) equals the same file extracted read-only (debugfs) from that bundle's .wic rootfs. The board runs that image: its root is SD card serial 0x00000231 and the kernel command line's root=PARTUUID=beb82b10-e9a3-49fd-b4e8-443a425f0198 equals the .wic's rootfs partition UUID.

build.features: recipe sets no further CMake options (WITH_LIBOQS left at the project default)

entropy.source: OpenSSL 3.6.3 default DRBG, seeded from getrandom(2)

Read-only: runner and bundle staged in a private mktemp dir under /tmp (tmpfs) and removed afterwards; engine-side persistence/logging env vars (SOFTHSMRUST_STATE_FILE, PQC_BEHAVIOUR_RING, PQC_BEHAVIOUR_SRC, PQC_AUTH_LOG, SOFTHSM3_OP_LOG) explicitly unset, so the run used a private token dir and did not touch the appliance's token store or behaviour ring; PQC_AWSLC_PQ_DISABLE not set. Board clock NTP-synchronised at run time. Variant A (appliance default): PQC_HW_DISABLE not set, exactly as run 2026-09-25-boards.

Effective OpenSSL configuration, recorded by the runner's own process (a wrapper that read it, then execv()ed into the runner with the same pid and environment): OPENSSL_CONF %s, so libcrypto uses its compiled-in default CONF_get1_default_config_file() = /usr/lib/ssl-3/openssl.cnf (openssl version -d: OPENSSLDIR "/usr/lib/ssl-3"), a symlink to /etc/ssl/openssl.cnf, SHA-256 4af7b0057963f18c3a08da9f557b3b7e4b95a34e7ab466c1eb615eb0c70dd499. Its [provider_sect] names only default (activate commented out, so the default provider is loaded implicitly); its .include /etc/ssl/openssl.cnf.d is an empty directory; no engine is configured; OPENSSL_MODULES is unset (/usr/lib/ossl-modules holds pkcs11.so, never activated).
